identity.original_title: Etaine: Magic Survivor / 伊泰恩：魔法幸存者

hooks.text: 120种法术分属8个元素，不同角色的元素选择带来不同打法
hooks.excerpt: There are 120 spells in the game, divided into 8 elements, each 15 spells. Each character can use different spell elements. Lead to different gameplay.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 法术消耗法力、神器占用法力上限，构筑必须权衡两者
hooks.excerpt: Unique mana management system: Mana is consumed when using spell. Activating an artifact requires occuping a portion of mana., and activating too many artifacts may not have enough mana to use spell. Mana management and balance is not only the feature of the game design, but also the difficulty of the game.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 提供20档难度、6种模式与10项特殊规则挑战
hooks.excerpt: There are 20 difficulty levels. There are 6 different game modes. There are 10 challenges using special rules!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
